text: Soren binds the tuned angles into the circuit and runs it for real -- twenty thousand shots on Qiskit Aer's noiseless simulator.
The sampled bitstring distribution comes back, and it concentrates hard on one answer: Felix's exact brute-force portfolio, Assets 03, 05, 08, and 12.
That single bitstring accounts for roughly 71% of all 20,000 shots -- with the next closest results just one asset swapped away, not random noise.
On the ideal simulator, this is a clean, genuinely impressive result, and the team's excitement about it is entirely earned.
Next: running this eight separate times to make sure it wasn't luck.
